import json
calls=[]
for line in open('counterparty-c2a-gate3-r27.jsonl'):
    try: d=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    if not isinstance(d,dict): continue
    m=d.get('message')
    if not isinstance(m,dict): continue
    c=m.get('content')
    if isinstance(c,list):
        for b in c:
            if isinstance(b,dict) and b.get('type')=='tool_use':
                calls.append(b)
import os
os.makedirs('/tmp/r28rev',exist_ok=True)
for i in [25,35,40,41,43,45,48,52,53,54,55,56,59]:
    open(f'/tmp/r28rev/c{i}.sh','w').write(calls[i]['input']['command'])
    s=calls[i]['input']['command']
    print(i, 'Nom:' in s, 'cand27' in s, 'Witness' in s, s.count('\n'))
